Who this is for

Important records leave your control.

For organisations whose documents are signed, sealed, handed over and judged by whoever receives them.

  1. Law firms

    Compiled records handled across a long proceeding, originating processes prepared for service, closing sets and executed agreements issued to clients, statutory registers and minute books, trust deeds and powers of attorney held by families for decades. The case law behind this exposure is on the evidence page.

  2. Audit and professional services

    Signed reports and financial statements issued to boards, regulators and lenders, printed components of assembled engagement files entering retention, engagement and representation letters, advisory and forensic reports relied on by third parties.

  3. Property developers

    Buyer handover packs issued on completion, deeds and title documents a client keeps for decades, corporate lease documents, facility management and service charge records.

  4. Corporate administration and company secretarial

    Board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filing packs, share certificates, closing sets and due diligence bundles.

  5. Government and public sector

    Tender and submission documents, certificates and official issuances, records retained under statutory obligation. A national court in Algeria operates three of these systems with full court staff, producing more than 15,000 hard cover packets annually.
